privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.disclaimer: This is placeholder content and does not constitute legal advice. Replace it with a privacy policy reviewed by your organization before launch.
privacyPage.paragraph1: Veluxa processes the media URLs you submit only to extract downloadable links from the originating platform, and does not permanently store the videos or images you download.
privacyPage.paragraph2: The Video to Audio tool converts videos entirely in your browser — the video is fetched only to convert it and is never stored on our servers.
privacyPage.paragraph3: We do not sell personal data. If we introduce analytics or third-party services in the future, this page will be updated to reflect that.
